sundai:fc:81.question: I bought a small _____ to remember my trip to Kyoto.
sundai:fc:81.fullSentence: I bought a small souvenir to remember my trip to Kyoto.

sundai:fc:82.question: We _____ arrived at the summit after five hours of climbing.
sundai:fc:82.fullSentence: We eventually arrived at the summit after five hours of climbing.

sundai:fc:83.question: 「回避する」を意味する単語はどれ？
sundai:fc:83.fullSentence: They tried to circumvent the new regulations.
sundai:fc:83.explanation: circumvent: 回避する。ventilator: 換気装置。venue: 会場。

sundai:fc:84.question: The concert was held at a large outdoor _____.
sundai:fc:84.fullSentence: The concert was held at a large outdoor venue.

sundai:fc:85.hint: 「合併する」という意味の動詞を考えましょう（同じ語根を持つ語には emerge, submerge などがある）。
sundai:fc:85.question: 「合併する」を意味する単語はどれ？
sundai:fc:85.fullSentence: The two companies decided to merge next year.
sundai:fc:85.explanation: merge: 合併する。emerge: 出現する。submerge: 水没させる。immerse: 没頭する。

sundai:fc:86.question: A new problem has _____ that we didn't expect.
sundai:fc:86.fullSentence: A new problem has emerged that we didn't expect.

sundai:fc:87.question: She likes to _____ herself in a good book on weekends.
sundai:fc:87.fullSentence: She likes to immerse herself in a good book on weekends.
sundai:fc:87.explanation: immerse: 浸す、没頭させる。immersion: 没頭。

sundai:fc:88.question: 「成功する、継承する」を意味する単語はどれ？
sundai:fc:88.fullSentence: His son will succeed him as company president.
sundai:fc:88.explanation: succeed: 成功する、継承する。successor: 後継者。successive: 連続する。

sundai:fc:89.question: It rained for three _____ days last week.
sundai:fc:89.fullSentence: It rained for three successive days last week.

sundai:fc:90.question: The economy slipped into a _____ last year.
sundai:fc:90.fullSentence: The economy slipped into a recession last year.

sundai:fc:91.question: 「譲歩」を意味する単語はどれ？
sundai:fc:91.fullSentence: Both sides made a small concession to reach a deal.

sundai:fc:92.question: This technology has grown at an _____ speed.
sundai:fc:92.fullSentence: This technology has grown at an unprecedented speed.

sundai:fc:93.question: The glacier began to _____ due to global warming.
sundai:fc:93.fullSentence: The glacier began to recede due to global warming.
sundai:fc:93.explanation: recede: 後退する。precede(先行する)、exceed(超える)、concede(譲歩する)と同語根。

sundai:fc:94.question: 「先行する」を意味する単語はどれ？
sundai:fc:94.fullSentence: A moment of silence preceded the speech.

sundai:fc:95.question: The temperature will _____ 35 degrees tomorrow.
sundai:fc:95.fullSentence: The temperature will exceed 35 degrees tomorrow.

sundai:fc:96.question: 「消費する」を意味する単語はどれ？
sundai:fc:96.fullSentence: This old refrigerator consumes a lot of electricity.
sundai:fc:96.explanation: consume: 消費する。resume: 再開する。assume: 想定する。presume: 推定する。

sundai:fc:97.question: The meeting will _____ after a short break.
sundai:fc:97.fullSentence: The meeting will resume after a short break.
sundai:fc:97.explanation: resume: 再開する。resumption: 再開。

sundai:fc:98.question: Let's not _____ anything without checking the facts first.
sundai:fc:98.fullSentence: Let's not assume anything without checking the facts first.
sundai:fc:98.explanation: assume: 想定する。assumption: 仮定。

sundai:fc:99.question: 「おそらく」を意味する単語はどれ？
sundai:fc:99.fullSentence: Presumably, the flight will be delayed because of the storm.
sundai:fc:99.explanation: presumably: おそらく。presumptuous: 厚かましい。

sundai:fc:100.question: Doctors often _____ a long recovery for this type of injury.
sundai:fc:100.fullSentence: Doctors often expect a long recovery for this type of injury.
sundai:fc:100.explanation: expect: 期待する。spect「見る」語根。

sundai:fc:101.question: 「疑う」を意味する単語はどれ？
sundai:fc:101.fullSentence: Police suspect that he was involved in the robbery.
sundai:fc:101.explanation: suspect: 疑う。prospect: 見込み。despise: 軽蔑する。

sundai:fc:102.question: There is little _____ of rain this weekend.
sundai:fc:102.fullSentence: There is little prospect of rain this weekend.

sundai:fc:103.question: He seems to _____ people who don't share his opinions.
sundai:fc:103.fullSentence: He seems to despise people who don't share his opinions.

sundai:fc:104.question: The museum has a rare _____ of a dinosaur bone.
sundai:fc:104.fullSentence: The museum has a rare specimen of a dinosaur bone.

sundai:fc:105.question: 「目立つ」を意味する単語はどれ？
sundai:fc:105.fullSentence: His bright red jacket was very conspicuous in the crowd.
sundai:fc:105.explanation: conspicuous: 目立つ。inspector: 検査官。skeptical: 懐疑的な。
